caption.en: Smoky-blue points and spun-glass whiskers emerge from a clear crystal feline form, caught mid-gesture with one paw gently lifted.
caption.zh: 煙灰藍重點色與拉絲玻璃鬍鬚從透明水晶貓身中浮現，凝結於輕抬前掌的瞬間神態。

alt.en: Clear and smoky-blue glass Siamese cat sculpture with blue eyes and raised paw against a muted teal background
alt.zh: 灰青背景前輕抬前掌的透明煙灰藍琉璃暹羅貓雕塑
